summary: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that the FDA granted Fast Track Designation for pelareorep combined with a checkpoint inhibitor to treat second-line or later squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal. No financial terms, premiums, or structural details are disclosed. The press release notes the designation supports expedited development and rolling review. This is a regulatory milestone, not a corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation category applies.
